requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original AW2 exploration panorama. Input image1 is our own village landscape STYLE reference, image2 our own prop/NPC style reference only. Match warm Vietnamese-inspired red tile roofs, amber lanterns, jade bamboo, flowers, natural stone and rich crisp painted pixel/chibi game art. Elevated three-quarter top-down view, not eye-level. Exact1536x1024 opaque single complete landscape. Camera looks at a rich environment with several depth layers around a large clear traversable central space. VERY IMPORTANT source image rectangle x430..1110,y310..720 must remain flat unobstructed walkable paving/wood: NO buildings/roofs/steps/water/shelves/tall props/people/walls in that central rectangle. The entire central region is walkable with tiny flat flowers/moss/dirt allowed only; perspective should be shallow enough not to imply steep stairs on floor. Buildings/tall objects/scenery only outside that rectangle, particularly the outer quarters. Do NOT bake NPCs, quest hint, chest, well, crates or game interfaces/text into floor. No words/letters/logos/watermarks, no center vignette or border. Fill the full frame with rich authored environment, center floor still pleasantly textured with low flat detail. No empty white/matte background. Subject: a lively but currently unoccupied village lantern street and market court connected to our village. Rich red-tile shopfronts and awnings at outer top and sides, hanging strings of warm paper lanterns overhead in OUTER apron, flower boxes, bamboo, ceramic pots, water rill/stone bridges beyond walkable area, layered receding rooftops. Clear terracotta/stone central plaza, subtle flat wear/moss detail. A market lane crosses west/east through the central space. Keep all shop architecture/canopies and vendor stalls OUTSIDE the protected central rectangle. Do not bake any people, chairs in central area, card/chess tables or quest markers into panorama. Depth from foreground garden fringe and distant shops, warm afternoon light, colorful cozy exploration village.
